title: orthosiphon tomentosus var. viscosus
intro: Orthosiphon tomentosus var. viscosus, commonly known as Java tea or Misai Kucing, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian cultures for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits in treating urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and as a diuretic. The health benefits of Java tea include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation, improving kidney function, and relieving symptoms of urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Java tea include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
